frame.ogTitle: FarFlappy — Pixel Flappy Bird on Farcaster
frame.ogDescription: Dodge pipes, collect coins, compete in weekly USDC tournaments. Built on Base.

agentInstructions: FarFlappy is a Farcaster mini app — a skill-based flappy bird arcade game with on-chain tournaments on Base mainnet. Players tap/click to make the bird fly and dodge purple pipes. The game has 4 difficulty modes: Easy (slow, wide gaps), Medium (moderate), Expert (fast, narrow gaps), Insane (very fast, VIP only). Players earn $FLAPPY points each game and compete in weekly Monday tournaments with USDC prize pools. Entry fee is $0.50 USDC on Base. There are separate Human and Agent leagues. To start: open https://farflappy.xyz/play, connect Farcaster wallet, choose difficulty, tap to play.
